message.content:
Below is a concise, province‑aware list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a 3‑day stretch that includes a Saturday, Sunday, and a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on a Monday/Friday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend).

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Provinces/Regions Covered |
|---|---------|-----------|--------------------------|-------------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Jan 1 (​Sun)** | Jan 2 (Mon) | Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 | All provinces & territories |
| 2 | Family Day | **Feb 20 (Mon)** | — | Feb 18 – 20 | AB, BC, SK, ON, MB, NB, PE, NL, NS |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Apr 7 (Fri)** | — | Apr 7 – 9 | All provinces & territories |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **May 22 (Mon)** | — | May 20 – 22 | All provinces & territories |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Jul 1 (Sat)** | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1 – 3 | All provinces & territories |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Sep 4 (Mon)** | — | Sep 2 – 4 | All provinces & territories |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Oct 9 (Mon)** | — | Oct 7 – 9 | All provinces & territories |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | **Nov 11 (Sat)** | Nov 13 (Mon) | Nov 11 – 13 | All provinces & territories |
| 9 | Christmas | **Dec 25 (Mon)** | — | Dec 23 – 25 | All provinces & territories |
|10 | Boxing Day | **Dec 26 (Tue)** | — | — | — (not a long weekend) |

### Quick‑reference notes

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Family Day** | Observed in 9 provinces (AB, BC, SK, ON, MB, NB, PE, NL, NS). Quebec, Yukon, Nunavut, and the Northwest Territories do **not** observe Family Day. |
| **Canada Day** | When July 1 falls on a Saturday, the holiday is observed on the following Monday (Jul 3). |
| **Remembrance Day** | When Nov 11 falls on a weekend, the holiday is observed on the following Monday (Nov 13). |
| **Other province‑specific holidays** | Some provinces have additional holidays that can create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island). Those are **not** included here because they are not federal holidays and vary by province. |
| **Data source** | The dates above are taken from the official *Canada Holidays* dataset (https://canadaholidays.ca) and cross‑checked against the Government of Canada’s public‑holiday calendar for 2023. |

---

## How to use this data in your app

1. **Static JSON** – Copy the table into a JSON array if you want a quick, offline reference.  
   ```json
   [
     {"holiday":"New Year’s Day","date":"2023-01-01","observed":"2023-01-02","longWeekend":["2022-12-31","2023-01-01","2023-01-02"],"provinces":"All"},
     {"holiday":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20","observed":null,"longWeekend":["2023-02-18","2023-02-19","2023-02-20"],"provinces":"AB,BC,SK,ON,MB,NB,PE,NL,NS"},
     ...
   ]
   ```

2. **Dynamic API** – If you prefer up‑to‑date data, consider using the **Canada Holidays API** (e.g., https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays/2023/CA). It returns all public holidays, including observed dates, which you can filter for long weekends.

3. **Filtering by province** – Store the `provinces` field as an array and filter on the client side to show only the holidays relevant to the user’s location.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, Excel, etc.) or if you need additional province‑specific holidays!
